name: Non-Exponential Free Flight Model
aliases: Generalized Boltzmann Equation (GBE) for non-exponential media
Generalized linear transport model for spatially correlated stochastic media
definition: A model for light transport in participating media where the distribution of scattering particles is positively correlated, resulting in non-exponential free path distributions with longer tails than Beer's Law. It allows artistic control over light bleeding depth.
summary: The Non-Exponential Free Flight Model simulates light transport in homogeneous media with spatially correlated particles, producing longer free path tails than standard exponential decay to enable artistic control over light bleeding.
